cqb.intent: Select and methodically traverse eligible buildings across an explicit area; move to the next building when current work ends.
sourceExecution: taskCQB scheduled loop searches House/Strategic/Ruins within radius and optional area; side-shared model-position cache selects nearest eligible building.
Native nearest-known enemy object drives close rush; source samples actual object/building positions. Room assignment selects first remaining node for ready actors.
Source removes a node when a unit is within30m or by a leader coin flip; this is not physical interior traversal proof.

Stuck indoor actors may be repositioned with setVehiclePosition when no player is near. Global FULL/FILE/no-flee/attackfalse and per-actor AUTOCOMBAT/SUPPRESSION changes accompany the task. No immutable episode deadline.
Area is polled repeatedly; cache does not bind position indices to a per-visit object transform. Final cleanup recalls actors and resets stance rather than restoring a complete mission baseline.

ZenClearModule already exposes explicit single squad/building; new ModuleClear adds native Zeus selectors backed by the same CortexOrderDispatch/Local executor. Optional ZEN is reused when present.
GroupTick SEARCH has a separate narrow remembered-contact indoor observation for up to two actors, not an area clearance executor.

CortexDiscover separately replays durable clearance through preflight. Original producer candidates stop at CANDIDATE_UNSEALED; no authenticated incoming native/settings/phase reconciliation consumer exists. Existing retiring callers already guard current ownership; adding a duplicate generic guard would not close that missing chain.

pointAssault.intent: Deliberate movement to an operator-selected point, optionally a forced retreat, distinct from attack against known contact.
sourceExecution: taskAssault clears known targets and imposes group policy/LINE/FULL/no-flee/attackfalse; disables multiple AI features and installs actor Fired/Hit handlers.
Each unit has its own PFH issuing repeated halfway moves and forceSpeed24 until within threshold; ATTACK may force temporary group recreation. No original total task deadline.
A group loop sends ready vehicles to destination and removes cargo boarding permission near it. Mixed crews/infantry share source group task context.

doAssaultUnitReset enables features to defaults, resets speed/stance, orders follow and may force an animation. Group cleanup imposes WEDGE/AWARE/YELLOW/attacktrue. These restore defaults rather than authored baselines.
currentCBE: Press attack is contact-driven, not an explicit arbitrary-point assault equivalent. Its bounded approach extension must not be counted as taskAssault source parity.

CortexRetreat already owns morale-based screened withdrawal, smoke, physical progress, original120-second episode and typed policy restoration; it does not expose this source arbitrary-destination operator task.
CortexGroupMove and selected-crew movement are lower-level writers, not an authored point-assault module by themselves.
pointAssault.disposition: Retain explicit destination assault/withdrawal intent. Compose on actual common operation/movement owners with immutable deadline and selected crew authority; reject copied per-actor PFHs, repeated raw moves, temporary group recreation, forced animation and default WEDGE/AI resets.
